$schema: See scripts/audit-check.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date.
$policy: Exceptions are deferrals, not pardons. An entry is only justified when the advisory cannot be fixed without a breaking upgrade AND the exposure does not reach a shipped build or a user's device. Anything reachable from the app bundle gets fixed, not listed.

allow.reason: Stack exhaustion on crafted brace patterns. Reached only through micromatch, which Metro (@expo/metro-file-map, metro-file-map), Jest (@jest/core, jest-config, jest-haste-map and others) and patch-package (find-yarn-workspace-root) use to match file globs written in this repo's own configuration. All of that runs on a developer's machine or in CI; none of it is part of a release build. The range is <=3.0.3 and 3.0.3 is the latest release, so there is no fixed version to move to.

RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw. Reached only through @expo/code-signing-certificates, which the Expo CLI uses to generate and check expo-updates code-signing certificates on a developer's machine. This app ships no node-forge: it is not imported by app code and is not in the bundle. The range is <=1.4.0 and 1.4.0 is the latest release, so there is no fixed version to move to.
